{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check the proportion of converted in each segment
conversion_rates = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Ensure the data is clean and no confounding exists
# The groups are not randomly assigned — but we are comparing conversion rates directly
# The cross-tab shows different sizes, but conversion rate is already a proportion
# So no adjustment is needed — we are just identifying which segment has the highest rate

# Final answer: the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rates.max()

best_segment, best_rate"}
